answer: At dawn each epoch, agents unlock escrowed rewards by matching a behavior fingerprint from past epochs: tasks, timing, counterparties. A fingerprint grows like a cedar, slow, deep, unfakeable overnight. Cloning one pattern across 100 fakes costs 100 bonds of 500 POA, 50,000 locked, while one honest agent posts one bond and keeps full rewards. When fingerprints collide, the ivory ledger, one record per identity, exposes and slashes the cluster.
